scenes.name: THE COPIER
lines: A photocopier copies any page, unread. So why can't a machine copy an unknown quantum state?
复印机什么页都能印，看都不用看。那为什么没有机器能复制一个未知的量子态？
The answer is not about measurement. It is about angles.
答案不在测量，而在角度。
A quantum machine acts like a rigid turn of the whole space, a turntable for arrows.
量子机器做的事，就像把整个空间刚性地转一转：一张放箭头的转盘。
A turn moves every arrow, but the overlap between any two arrows stays exactly the same.
一转，每支箭头都动了，可任意两支之间的重叠分毫不变。
Feed in psi with a blank page. Its overlap with phi and the same blank is z times one.
把 ψ 和一张白纸一起送进去：它和 φ 加同一张白纸的重叠，是 z 乘 1。
After copying, the outputs are psi psi and phi phi. Their overlap is z times z.
复制之后，输出是 ψψ 和 φφ，它们的重叠是 z 乘 z。

scenes.name: ONE NUMBER
lines: Try z equal to zero point six.
试一个数：z = 0.6。
Going in, the overlap is zero point six. Coming out, it would have to be zero point three six.
进机器时重叠是 0.6；出来时却得是 0.36。
The angle would have to open from fifty-three degrees to sixty-nine. A rigid turn cannot open an angle.
夹角得从 53° 张到 69°。刚性转动张不开任何角。
Slide z from zero to one. The gap closes only at the two ends.
把 z 从 0 滑到 1：这道缺口只在两端合上。

scenes.name: ONLY ZERO OR ONE
lines: Lean checks this for any complex inner product space, with one machine and one blank.
Lean 内核检验：在任意复内积空间里，同一台机器，同一张白纸。
If it copies two unit states exactly, their overlap equals its own square.
只要它精确复制了两个单位态，它们的重叠就等于自身的平方。
So the two states are identical, or perpendicular.
所以这两个态要么完全相同，要么彼此正交。
A copier can only copy what is already told apart.
能复制的，只有早已分得清的东西。

scenes.name: HIDE IT IN A ROOM
lines: Why did we think safety means copies? That habit comes from paper.
我们凭什么以为，安全就得靠备份？这个习惯来自纸张。
A quantum code hides the state instead. Three bits hold one, in four perpendicular rooms.
量子码改为把态藏起来：三个比特装一个，住进四间互相垂直的房。
An error does not smear the state. It carries it, whole, into another room.
错误不会把态抹花，而是把它整个搬进另一间房。
Each room has its own key. A key turned in the wrong room opens nothing.
每间房有自己的钥匙；拿去开别的房，什么也打不开。

scenes.name: A NUDGE, NOT A FLIP
lines: Now just nudge the middle bit. Seventy percent stays home, thirty percent moves next door, still in superposition.
现在只把中间那个比特轻推一下：七成留在原房，三成挪到隔壁，两者仍是叠加。
Decode. The cross terms vanish, and zero point seven plus zero point three gives back the state.
解码：交叉项全部消失，0.7 加 0.3，原态完整交回。
Lean checks it for any matrices: with perpendicular rooms, decoding returns the noise trace times the state.
Lean 内核检验：对任意矩阵，只要房间两两正交，解码就给出噪声矩阵的迹乘原态。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: No-cloning is only a necessary condition. It builds no copier, and near copies are another story.
不可克隆只是必要条件：它不造复印机，近似复制是另一回事。
This code guards against single bit flips only. A phase flip slips through unseen.
这套码只防单个比特翻转；相位翻转会悄悄溜过。
And this decoder lives on the rooms. A full channel needs one more piece for the rest of the space.
这里的解码只是房间上的一条公式；要成为完整的信道，还得给其余空间补上一块。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter fourteen.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第十四章
